title: Latent (MLA) attention in Triton: decode tokens and verify windows of every query head over a paged cache of compressed rows (a latent and a rotary key a position, the latent the value too), split over KV partitions and merged, with sinks

window.what: a tile of BLOCK_M query rows (a row's columns times its heads) over pieces b, b + PARTS, ... of PIECE positions, each piece's latents loaded once for the scores and the values, the states merged in partition order

BLOCK_M.what: query rows a program (at most the window's columns times the heads)

PIECE.what: positions a piece: the unit a partition takes and its softmax's block

PARTS.what: partitions a row's pieces go to, piece i to i mod PARTS (0: the rule, 2 x SMs over the heads' 16-row tiles, 1 to 128)

STAGES.what: Triton's software-pipeline stages over the pieces

VSPLIT.what: programs sharing a tile, each with R / VSPLIT of the latent output columns (each computes the tile's scores)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper (paged latent and rotary caches, BF16)

prompt.what: a prompt chunk of one sequence: its tokens times their heads in tiles of BLOCK_M rows over the pieces of PIECE positions in order, causal, one online softmax, the output written directly (no partitions)

BLOCK_M.what: query rows a program (tokens times heads)

PIECE.what: positions a piece: the softmax's block

STAGES.what: Triton's pipeline stages over the pieces

VSPLIT.what: programs sharing a tile, each with R / VSPLIT of the output columns (each computes the scores)

yardstick.library: FlashInfer BatchMLAPagedAttentionWrapper with causal prompt rows
